items.text: Puka Nacua listed GTD/OPTIMISM in weekend summary then confirmed ACTIVE vs Raiders after calf issue; Schefter/Rapoport corroborated official active.
items.why: Rams optimistic Saturday, felt better, no setbacks; officially active Sunday.
items.implication: Full or near-full WR1 role expected; reverse any Atwell/Mumpfield beneficiary fades.
items.opportunity: Primary target share and red-zone looks locked in with Adams out longer-term.

items.text: Breece Hall GTD/PESSIMISM in ETR summary; officially INACTIVE (quad) after Rapoport unlikely report. Missed third straight.
items.why: Not full participant; early return attempt failed; sources said unlikely.
items.implication: Handcuff/backup (Allen) locked RB1/2 volume vs MIA; monitor Week 8 return.
items.opportunity: Clear path for Jets backfield lead snaps/carries without Hall.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT in ETR weekend injury summary (ankle); confirmed inactive, third straight miss; Huntley started.
items.why: Downgraded Saturday from questionable after limited practice; high ankle sprain context.
items.implication: Ravens pass game downgrade; Flowers/Andrews/Likely still viable but lower ceiling without Lamar dual-threat.
items.opportunity: No Lamar rushing TDs or scramble production; Huntley volume to skill players.

items.text: Jonah Coleman LOVE/upgrade: first game back led Broncos backfield 50% snaps, 41% rush, 34% routes. Dobbins only 21% snaps; Harvey fluky long TD.
items.why: Immediate lead shares post-return over incumbents.
items.implication: Coleman RB2/flex priority; Dobbins/Harvey downgraded to handcuff/committee.
items.opportunity: Coleman primary early-down/rush/route work; others reduced.

items.text: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) actually hurt but uncertain severity; watching list with Tracy.
items.why: Exited/hamstring; Levitan confirms real injury vs minor.
items.implication: Potential miss or limited next week; Tracy or committee beneficiaries.
items.opportunity: If out, lead back snaps/carries open in Giants backfield.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs ankle turned on purposeful slide; Levitan: almost certainly fine. Would have been tilting if self-injured avoiding TD.
items.why: Purposeful slide, not contact injury; post-game assessment positive.
items.implication: No downgrade for Week 8; maintain elite RB1 ranking/usage.
items.opportunity: Continued high snap/route/target/carry share in Lions offense.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY then confirmed ACTIVE for MNF vs DAL (hamstring/back); Schefter/Rapoport noted active with Stowers/Calcaterra.
items.why: Returned after missing two; post-game said hamstring great, back not expected to sideline.
items.implication: Lead back role resumes though possibly limited snaps; reverse Gainwell pure lead fades.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/red-zone and early-down work back; monitor snap share post-MNF.

items.text: Josh Jacobs listed IN and activated/expected to play Week 7; Schefter confirmed among actives.
items.why: Activated from IR/absence; full return to Packers backfield.
items.implication: Reclaims lead RB role; handcuffs/backups fade; ROS RB2+ value.
items.opportunity: Snaps, carries, red-zone work expansion as primary back.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks both OUT; Eagles activations included Stowers/Calcaterra for MNF.
items.why: Hamstring (Smith) and related; confirmed out for MNF.
items.implication: Target vacuum for remaining Eagles pass-catchers; Goedert/AJ Brown elevated if healthy.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets to other WRs/TEs; slot/outside shares up.

items.text: Can we PLEASE put some respect on Tee Higgins’ name? (post big performance context).
items.why: Consistent production deserves higher ranking/respect vs name-value peers.
items.implication: Start with confidence as WR2; buy-low if still discounted.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value-touch thesis: worst runner (last YPC 3.1, poor EPA/RYOE) yet fantasy RB13 PPR ppg via 9 inside-5 carries + league-leading 45 RB targets.
items.why: Inefficient rushing offset by elite goal-line and receiving opportunity.
items.implication: Sustainable fantasy RB2/flex despite poor efficiency; hold/buy if discounted on YPC.
items.opportunity: Continued inside-5 and target lead drives TD/reception floor.
items.conflict: Efficiency metrics conflict with production; volume thesis prevails for fantasy.

items.text: Tony Pollard EXPLODED Sunday; Berry: if you can turn big game into sell-high in fantasy, take it.
items.why: Outlier explosion likely not sustainable baseline.
items.implication: Trade for more consistent RB2/WR2; fade as must-start if value peaks.
items.opportunity: Recent high carries/TDs but committee/role risk ahead.

items.text: Texans WR routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks: Nico Collins 24 (clear lead), Noel 15 (left turf toe), Hutchinson 15, Boutte 13, Harrison 8, Tank Dell only 6 in first game back since 2024.
items.why: Dell limited return snaps/routes; Collins dominated opportunity.
items.implication: Nico locked WR1; Dell ramp-up slow, monitor Week 8 role expansion.
items.opportunity: Collins 80%+ route share; Dell low single-digit routes on return.

items.text: Xavier Worthy 33 routes (lead) on 36 Mahomes dropbacks in second game without Rice; has never topped 83 rec yards in 37 career games despite volume.
items.why: Rice hamstring absence funnels routes to Worthy as clear WR1.
items.implication: High floor volume but historical ceiling cap; WR2/3 with TD upside, not elite WR1.
items.opportunity: 33+ routes, primary target in KC passing game while Rice out.
items.conflict: Route share high but yards ceiling historically low.
